## Twenty One Capital Buys $10 Million of Bitcoin, Increasing Holdings to ~43,668 BTC


November 16, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/307816567/files/doc_news/Twenty-One-Capital-Buys-10-Million-of-Bitcoin-Increasing-Holdings-to-43668-BTC-2026.pdf)


*Adds 154.32 BTC following weekend selloff; Company intends to make additional opportunistic purchases*


AUSTIN, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Twenty One Capital, Inc. ("Twenty One" or "XXI") (NYSE: XXI) today announced that it purchased 154.32 bitcoin for approximately $10 million at an average price of approximately $64,801.01 per bitcoin. Twenty One funded the purchase with cash, bringing the company’s total holdings to approximately 43,668 bitcoin as of November 16, 2026.


“Bitcoin is our benchmark for every investment decision we make. Any business we acquire has to beat simply buying more Bitcoin, and this weekend’s drop in price made adding Bitcoin an easy decision,” said Rapha Zagury, Chief Executive Officer of Twenty One. “Every dollar we spend, whether on Bitcoin, acquisitions, or buybacks, is weighed against maintaining flexibility to run our business well. We’ll keep buying Bitcoin when the opportunity is right and we remain focused on growing long-term shareholder value.”


The purchase follows the release of[XXI’s November 13 shareholder letter](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.xxi.money%2Fnews%2Fnews-details%2F2026%2FTwenty-One-Capital-Issues-Shareholder-Letter-From-CEO-Rapha-Zagury%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54642363&newsitemid=20261116392207&lan=en-US&anchor=XXI%27s+November+13+shareholder+letter&index=1&md5=ebd5cb65736911936b4684965a0fb124) , which outlined Twenty One’s vision to build cash-generating businesses around its Bitcoin treasury. Twenty One seeks businesses capable of producing cash after meeting operating costs, reinvestment needs and financing obligations.


Twenty One plans to make additional Bitcoin purchases, which is core to the company’s strategy, with the amount and timing determined by market conditions, available liquidity, and competing investment opportunities.


**About Twenty One**


Twenty One is a Bitcoin-focused operating company. Designed to pair one of the largest Bitcoin treasuries in the public markets with operating businesses, Twenty One aims to provide shareholders with direct, capital-efficient exposure to Bitcoin through a growing Bitcoin-native platform. For more information, visit[https://twentyonecapital.com/investors](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftwentyonecapital.com%2Finvestors&esheet=54642363&newsitemid=20261116392207&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Ftwentyonecapital.com%2Finvestors&index=2&md5=34be798d767b7deeb2ed89c6ad6a6c72) .
